slides.heading: UPI PAYMENTS ABOVE ₹2,000
slides.sub: PAID BY THE MERCHANT · CAPPED AT ₹300
slides.body: Up to ₹2,000 stays free. Consumers pay nothing, and apps may not add a platform fee.

slides.heading: WHAT THE MERCHANT PAYS (₹)
slides.body: NPCI's own examples. Without the cap, ₹1 lakh would cost ₹400.

slides.heading: WHO GETS THE 0.4%?
slides.text: “The operational parameters, fee distribution models, and category caps are decided by the UPI and Services Steering Committee”

slides.heading: PAYTM'S MARGIN TODAY
slides.body: Payment processing margin was 'comfortably above 4bps' in Q1 FY27. Even a small share of 0.4% is large next to that.

slides.heading: THE RACE FOR MERCHANTS
slides.text: “With new monetization levers emerging, we want to walk the talk by investing back into the ecosystem”

slides.heading: THE MOAT QUESTION
slides.label: FOCUS MOAT · D2 SWITCHING COSTS
slides.body: Every provider earns the same regulated rate. The moat is how many merchants you hold, and how hard it is for them to leave.

slides.heading: THE BEAR CASE
items: A COMMITTEE SET THE RATE; ONE CAN CHANGE IT
NEW REVENUE SPENT ON ACQUIRING MERCHANTS
